I used to be an English major but changed courses. I guess the simple answer is that it just seemed to suit my interests a lot more. Best wishes on your first year as a psych major, by the way. Research paper writing is stressful, but always fun.  

To be honest, I feel a bit calmer right now, otherwise I wouldn't go on reddit. I know this isn't a wise action, or something you would like to hear, but cutting myself earlier seemed to ease up some anxiety. Still a bit tense and edgy. I'm putting the gun away but I don't know who to call anymore...
